api.title: FaceSDK API Documentation
api.intro: FaceSDK provides face recognition services based on CompreFace, supporting face detection, face comparison, face search, subject management, and RGB liveness detection.

detection.desc: Face Detection - Detect face locations and features in images
detection.paramThreshold: Detection threshold, range 0-1, default 0.5, faces below this value will be filtered

verification.desc: Face Verification (1:1) - Compare similarity between two face images

recognition.desc: Face Recognition (1:N) - Search for similar faces in the database
recognition.paramThreshold: Similarity threshold, range 0-1, default 0.8, results below this value will be filtered

antispoofing.desc: RGB Liveness Detection - Determine if the face in the image is a real person
antispoofing.hint: Return value range 0-1, above 0.5 is considered live (real person), below 0.5 is considered non-live (attack)
